cascades.name: Omni Tracker: full dashboard
cascades.description: One canonical KLMT packet becomes a navigable dossier. The shell is native; specialized regexes render the state, motive, psyche, scene, inventory, relationship map, inspectables and knowledge graph.
cascades.notes: The stable preview ID stands in for Lumiverse’s runtime random macro. Host actions are not executed.

cascades.name: Weather studio
cascades.description: Gabi writes a tiny weather preset. A resolver expands it into a weather packet; the next native regex builds the illustrated header.
cascades.notes: Weather photographs use the original preset’s remote GitHub URLs. The native header still renders offline, but the photograph requires network access; no image is bundled or substituted.

cascades.name: CYOA Multi: character routes
cascades.description: Native decision dock → actor selection → Gabrielle or Zephyr routes. Declarative popover and details controls work in the isolated browser preview; route submission remains host-only.
cascades.notes: Three original Lumiverse stages: Modal → Popover ID → Popover Wiring. The sandbox simulates only the generated 32-digit popover ID. Dock, actor selection, route expansion and close work through native HTML, while host send actions remain disabled.
